TODAY — the red lines are the two gutters the page actually uses (16px and 24px).

Three left edges, gaps alternating 20 / 76, two near-identical creams, titles at 16 / 30 / 30, three card styles. Kept here only as the before.

CHOSEN — the build target.

Five rules, applied everywhere:
1. One gutter — 20px. Sections stop owning horizontal padding; the column owns it. Only deliberate exception is a right-only bleed for scrolling rails.
2. One rhythm — 44px between sections, 0 inside. No more gap-5 plus py-14 stacking to 76.
3. One ground — #fbf9f4 throughout. Contrast comes from white cards, never a second cream.
4. One header shape — rule + eyebrow, 24px/800 title, one line of body, optional link out.
5. One card — white, 20px radius, 1px #e8e2d5, no shadow. Terracotta #b04a15 is the only accent that acts; unclaimed gold #9a6b12 survives as a marker on that section only.

Also reordered: live needs first, then still-waiting, campaigns, the one pathway choice, then trust as a closing list rather than a boxed band.

OPEN: Be the Change and Coming Soon are not drawn. They take the same header shape — say where they go, or whether they go.

NOT CHOSEN — kept for reference, not being built.

Worth stealing from later if the restrained page feels flat once it is live: Editorial's numbered register, Feed's inline handover proof (completed handovers as feed entries rather than a stats band), Ledger's waiting column.
